evidence.quote: You've likely set the `log.mining.strategy` to `online_catalog`, and when using this mode you can't mix DDL and DML events in the same mining step iteration.

notes: Schema error when DML/DDL/DML run back-to-back is documented online_catalog limitation; fix is lock-step DDL or hybrid strategy. Reporter accepted.
